locations.label: Galleria Exo Suits
locations.description: Collect an Exo Suit from Galleria and open routes to Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator. Prepare upgrades and decontamination access. Exo Slam is specifically required for the later number panel. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Spa decontamination
locations.description: Resort decontamination is in the Spa; Oz’s arena has a separate event pad. Collect an Exo Suit from Galleria and open routes to Lounge, Reception and Tidal Generator. Prepare upgrades and decontamination access. Exo Slam is specifically required for the later number panel. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Hidden Tidal terminal
locations.description: Shoot the three valves along Tidal Generator’s spiral staircase until each shows a BLUE lamp: left of its power generator, above the right yellow door, and right of the AMR9 wallbuy. The room halfway up the staircase opens. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Floodable airlock
locations.description: Hold interact at Lounge’s underwater door to depressurize it. This takes a sustained hold, but its progress persists if you leave to retrieve equipment. Obtain a Goliath suit from a supply drop; it is a random reward rather than a guaranteed round spawn. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Galleria capacitor
locations.description: Bring electrical enemies to the Galleria capacitor and allow their electrical hits to charge it. Other electric variants also work. Remove ordinary attackers and leave an escape route: losing Exo movement in this space can trap you. Continue until its display reads 100% and Angie confirms power diversion; use the display instead of counting guessed hits. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Reception monitors
locations.description: At Reception, interact with the glowing right-hand monitor. First record which colour occupies each physical screen from LEFT to RIGHT; the arrangement varies. Record the flashing colours in order, including repeats, and interact with their corresponding screens. A cheerful tone and power-diversion line confirm success. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Four-digit number panel
locations.description: Read the target TOP row and current BOTTOM row near the upstairs terminal. Match all four digits using the actions below. Digits wrap through 0–9; the first counts zombie hits, so a single multi-target slam can advance it several times. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Nine platform patterns
locations.description: At spawn, cross each blue-platform pattern using Exo movement and reach its final platform. It bounces you back and changes the pattern; complete nine. A platform disappears shortly after being stood on, then returns, so pause safely when an upcoming platform is absent. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
